Overview Phase 1 Phase 2 Phase 3 Canvas submissions Assessment

Private team submissions · All three phases

Canvas Submission Workflow

Submit the macro forecast first, then the three abbreviated client IPS statements. Later gates retain their own team submissions so the decision trail and evidence remain private and reviewable.

Canvas is the private submission record

The Canvas assignment controls the due date, points, availability window, and attempt policy. This guide controls the required package, filenames, and public/private boundary.

Rules that apply at every gate

Submit each assignment and verify its receipt

  • Use the team name entered on Team Information in every filename. Replace [TeamName] with that name, omitting spaces and punctuation (for example, Harbor Analysts becomes HarborAnalysts); use the same spelling in every submission. Do not add individual student names to filenames.
  • One designated submitter uploads each required package for the Canvas group; every team member confirms the receipt before the deadline.
  • Keep formulas live in required XLSX files. Export narrative and exhibit deliverables to PDF unless PPTX or XLSX is explicitly required.
  • Put only licensed FactSet evidence in the private evidence ZIP. Do not place credentials, raw student data, or unrelated downloads in the bundle.
  • Before submitting, open every file, confirm the assigned clients and all five role owners are visible where required, and verify that all cited as-of dates match the analysis.
  • After upload, open the Canvas submission receipt and confirm that every required filename appears. A local file or public-repository link is not a submission.

Phase 1 · Part 1

BUS331 Investment Committee · Phase 1 Part 1 · Macro Forecast

Purpose and sequence

Submit the common 12-month macro forecast before applying it to assigned clients. The separate Part 2 assignment completes the three client IPS statements.

Complete and submit the macro starter workbook as the Part 1 group assignment. One designated team member submits for the group; every team member verifies the Canvas receipt. Carry the submitted forecast into Part 2 and document any later revision in the decision record.

Upload these exact files

Required fileBUS331_[TeamName]_Phase1_Macro.xlsxCompleted macro starter workbook with historical evidence, human-first read, source-dated consensus comparison, inflation forecast, and probability-weighted bull/base/bear scenarios.

Pre-submission check

  • All five macro responsibilities have named owners; a four-person team may assign two responsibilities to one person.
  • Historical claims use the labeled series, frequency, units, and source dates; current observations are distinguished from 12-month forecasts.
  • GDP growth, CPI inflation, fed funds, and sentiment forecasts include a comparable external reference, source, date, horizon, and rationale when available; an unavailable comparison is explained.
  • Bull, base, and bear probabilities total 100%, and the weighted forecast calculates from the three scenarios.

Allowed file extensions: .xlsx

Phase 1 · Part 2

BUS331 Investment Committee · Phase 1 Part 2 · Client IPS Statements

Decision recorded

Consider RRTTLLLU for each assigned client and complete one abbreviated IPS statement for each client.

Consider RRTTLLLU for each assigned client and complete one abbreviated IPS statement for each client. Combine the three completed IPS statements into one PDF in assigned-client order and submit it for the group. No contract or approval gate is required. No client interviews, signatures, separate memo, or Decision Record are required. Confirm the Canvas receipt after upload.

Upload these exact files

Required fileBUS331_[TeamName]_Phase1_ClientIPS.pdfOne combined PDF containing the three completed client IPS documents in assigned-client order.

Pre-submission check

  • RRTTLLLU has been considered for each assigned client.
  • The PDF contains one completed abbreviated IPS statement for each assigned client.

Allowed file extensions: .pdf

Phase 2 Canvas gate

BUS331 Investment Committee · Phase 2 Gate · Build and Challenge

Decision recorded

Approve, revise, or reject each client portfolio after the locked baseline, instructor-issued Scenario Reveal, full IPS review, corrective trade, and re-test.

Phase 2 has two checkpoints. At the instructor-designated baseline checkpoint, submit the Baseline Snapshot before the Scenario Reveal. After the reveal, complete the corrective trade and re-test, then submit the complete Gate 2 package. One designated team member submits for the group; every team member verifies the Canvas receipt.

Upload these exact files

Required fileBUS331_[TeamName]_Phase2_CME.xlsxCompleted capital-market-expectations and optimization workbook.
Required fileBUS331_[TeamName]_Phase2_SecuritySelection.xlsxCompleted final-holding scorecards, selective decision notes, Holding & Exposure Reality Checks, conditional direct-security evidence, and FactSet Evidence Log.
Required fileBUS331_[TeamName]_Phase2_BaselineSnapshot.pdfSubmitted baseline allocation, IPS scorecard, and initial stress result retained before the Scenario Reveal.
Required fileBUS331_[TeamName]_Phase2_StressTest.xlsxScenario Release Log, integrated allocation, full IPS scorecard, revealed-scenario results, corrective trades, and re-test.
Required fileBUS331_[TeamName]_Phase2_DecisionRecord.xlsxCurrent committee record with client-by-client votes, dissent, actions, owners, and deadlines.
Required fileBUS331_[TeamName]_Phase2_LicensedEvidence.zipPrivate course-use evidence files referenced by the FactSet Evidence Log; no credentials or unrelated exports.

Pre-submission check

  • Each client portfolio contains 8–10 holdings and never more than 10; funds and ETFs are primary, individual securities total no more than two or three, and no slot is filled without a purpose.
  • Every final holding has the concise scorecard, realistic alternatives are rejected briefly, and direct individual securities include rationale, idiosyncratic-risk, and position-size evidence.
  • The Portfolio Manager recorded overlap, concentration, final-selection, weight, and trade-off decisions; the Risk and Derivatives Analyst recorded residual risk and a supported hedge or no-hedge conclusion.
  • The baseline snapshot was submitted before the Scenario Reveal; every client allocation totals 100%, all IPS objectives and constraints were re-tested, and every revealed breach has a corrective trade and full re-test.
  • Every team member recorded one Phase 2 vote and can identify their recommendation, alternative rejected, key trade-off, and evidence reviewed.

Allowed file extensions: .pdf, .xlsx, .zip

Phase 3 Canvas gate

BUS331 Investment Committee · Phase 3 Gate · Defend the Recommendation

Decision recorded

Issue one integrated recommendation for all three clients, preserve the audit trail, and arrive ready for the scheduled committee defense.

Submit the complete Phase 3 package before the scheduled committee defense. One designated team member submits for the group; every team member verifies the Canvas receipt.

Upload these exact files

Required fileBUS331_[TeamName]_Phase3_DecisionMemo.pdfFinal committee decision memo with recommendation first, client-specific actions, reservations, and monitoring triggers.
Required fileBUS331_[TeamName]_Phase3_TechnicalDossier.pdfAuditable exhibit book linking macro, mandates, allocations, security evidence, stress results, corrections, and sources.
Required fileBUS331_[TeamName]_Phase3_Presentation.pptxFinal visual committee presentation with balanced speaking responsibility and a compact role-specific investment-committee defense.
Required fileBUS331_[TeamName]_Phase3_DecisionRecord.xlsxFinal vote, dissent or reservations, implementation actions, Analyst Decision Log, and AI audit appendix.
Required fileBUS331_[TeamName]_Phase3_LicensedEvidence.zipFinal private evidence bundle containing only licensed supporting files cited in the dossier and Evidence Log.

Pre-submission check

  • The memo, dossier, presentation, and decision record state the same allocations, securities, and monitoring actions.
  • Every recommendation traces backward to a Phase 1 client guardrail and forward to a monitoring trigger.
  • Every material number has a source, definition, unit, as-of date, interpretation, and limitation.
  • Each member can defend role-specific evidence, the Decision Log contribution, one rejected alternative and key trade-off, and answer targeted questions within the compact committee defense.

Allowed file extensions: .pdf, .pptx, .xlsx, .zip

Submission receipt

The gate is not complete until the team confirms Canvas

After the designated submitter uploads each package, every member opens its Canvas receipt and confirms the required filenames. Keep the Part 2 IPS submission receipt with your team files. If a file is missing or cannot be opened, use the attempt and revision policy shown in Canvas.
